businesses.business: regulated water, wastewater and recycled water utilities

offering_description.value: Owns and operates regulated water, wastewater and recycled water utilities serving homes and businesses in master-planned communities in the Phoenix, Arizona area. It collects, treats and delivers water and reclaimed water through its own infrastructure and bills customers under rates set by the state regulator.

primary_services.value: water utility service; wastewater collection and treatment; utility billing

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential customers in master-planned communities; B2B: commercial customers, developers and homebuilders

end_markets.value: residential communities; commercial real estate; land development

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated water, wastewater and recycled water rates and monthly usage charges; other: connection and hook-up fees from developers and new homes

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs water wells, treatment plants and pipelines, selling to end customers in service areas

geography_served.value: US regional: Arizona: Phoenix metropolitan area, mainly Pinal and Maricopa counties

specialization.value: related lines: water, wastewater and recycled water utility services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct utility connections and billing to customers through owned pipeline networks

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rate-regulated utility under Arizona Corporation Commission, also ADEQ and EPA water quality rules
